summary: Sporting News' Week 13 fantasy football PPR wide receiver rankings by Nick Musial, covering top plays, sleepers, busts and injuries. Six teams are on bye, thinning the pool, with Tyreek Hill and CeeDee Lamb leading the list. The piece closes with a ranked list of 76 WRs and a Draft Sharks projections promo.
one_line: Sporting News ranks Week 13 PPR fantasy wide receivers, led by Tyreek Hill, with sleepers, busts, bye-week and injury notes.
key_facts: Six teams are on bye in Week 13: the Ravens, Bills, Vikings, Raiders, Giants, and Bears.
Notable WRs omitted due to byes include Davante Adams, Stefon Diggs, Justin Jefferson, DJ Moore, Zay Flowers, Jakobi Meyers, and Jordan Addison.
Tyreek Hill (Dolphins @ Commanders) is ranked No. 1, with CeeDee Lamb (Cowboys vs. Seahawks) at No. 2.
Amon-Ra St. Brown has seen at least nine targets in each of his past six games.
Mike Evans has totaled four TDs over the past three weeks and sits at No. 5.
Ja'Marr Chase averaged over 20 yards per reception in Week 12, but the drop-off from Joe Burrow to Jake Browning is described as massive.
Tank Dell rounds out the top 10 as a trusted option of C.J. Stroud's.
Listed sleepers are Curtis Samuel, Jayden Reed, Lynn Bowden Jr., Jonathan Mingo, Cedric Tillman, and DeVante Parker.
Jayden Reed has scored in three straight games.
Lynn Bowden Jr., A.T. Perry and Keith Kirkwood are the only healthy Saints WRs right now.
Busts to beware of include Terry McLaurin, Puka Nacua, Tutu Atwell, Drake London, Tyler Lockett, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba.
Terry McLaurin is averaging just 42 receiving yards over his past three games and faces Jalen Ramsey.
Cleveland entered Week 12 allowing the fewest fantasy points per game to WRs.
Chris Olave (concussion), Amari Cooper (ribs), Demario Douglas (concussion), and Rashid Shaheed (thigh) were left out of the initial rankings due to injuries.
Josh Palmer (knee) is eligible to come off IR this week but probably won't play against New England.
